# Zonic Media

> Zonic Media (Zonic Media LLC) is a US-based digital marketing agency in Dover, Delaware that helps local and service-based businesses grow online through Google Business Profile (GBP/GMB) reinstatement, verification, and optimization, local SEO, web design, and Google Ads. Its flagship service is GMB reinstatement: recovering suspended, disabled, and pending-verification Google Business Profiles, with 700+ profiles reinstated and verified, a 5–7 business day average resolution time, and a "No Fix, No Charge" policy on the reinstatement fee. The agency serves clients across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, the UAE, and India.

## About

- Company: Zonic Media LLC
- Location: 8 The Green, STE B, Dover, DE 19901, United States
- Contact: contact@zonicllc.com | +1-302-726-9736
- Areas served: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, United Arab Emirates, India
- Core focus: Google Business Profile (GMB/GBP) reinstatement, verification, and optimization; local SEO; web design; Google Ads (PPC)
- Trust signals: 700+ Google Business Profiles reinstated and verified, 5.0 rating on Clutch (21 reviews), average reinstatement resolution in 5–7 business days, free suspension audit, No Fix, No Charge reinstatement fee policy
- Independent reviews: [Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/zonicllc.com) and [Clutch](https://clutch.co/profile/zonic-media) — reviewers highlight fast GMB suspension recovery, quality web design, and quick communication

## Google Business Profile Services (flagship)

- [GMB Reinstatement Service](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/gmb-reinstatement-help): Recovers suspended and disabled Google Business Profiles. Handles soft suspensions, hard suspensions, disabled listings, and profiles suspended pending verification. Free suspension audit, custom appeal within 24–48 hours, average reinstatement in 5–7 business days, No Fix, No Charge on the reinstatement fee, post-reinstatement optimization included.
- [Rejected GBP Appeal — Escalation Desk](https://www.zonicllc.com/gmb-reinstatement-service-agency): For Google Business Profile cases that have already failed at least one appeal — rejected reinstatement requests, profiles disabled after repeated attempts, listings suspended again after reinstatement, and multi-location or agency portfolios. Decodes Google's rejection wording, fixes the root cause, and re-files on the correct track. Free case review, No Fix, No Charge on the reinstatement fee.
- [GMB Verification Help](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/gmb-verification-help): Fixes failed postcard, video, phone, and email verification and verification loops.
- [GBP Verification Rules 2026](https://www.zonicllc.com/google-business-profile-verification-help-2026): What changed in Google Business Profile verification for 2026 — video as the default method since 2024, live video calls introduced in 2025, the six elements Google checks in a verification video, the edits that trigger re-verification, and how service-area businesses film without a storefront.
- [GMB Optimization](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/gmb-optimization): Google Business Profile optimization to rank in the local Map Pack.
- [Google Map Pack Ranking](https://www.zonicllc.com/local-seo-google-business-optimization): How local 3-Pack rankings are decided — proximity, relevance and prominence, which of them a business can actually move, geo-grid rank scanning across a whole service area, and why a profile ranks #1 at its own address but disappears a few miles away. Free geo-grid scan.
- [GBP Services for Real Estate Agents](https://www.zonicllc.com/services/google-business-profile-services-real-estate-agents): Reinstatement, verification, and management for realtors and brokers.
